statement: The holder chose where to run the analysis. Figures are the portal’s planning estimates from published grid factors and power profiles. They are not measured for this job, not verified by anyone, and not a certified emission reduction.

workload.assumption: Same run time assumed on every machine; real GPUs differ.

method: energy = power × duration × PUE; emissions = energy × location-based grid factor. Unit follows ISO/IEC 21031 (SCI); offsets are not counted.

chosen.gridSource: Electricity Maps, Grid in Review 2025 — flow-traced (consumption-based, imports included). Production-based on the same page: 19.0. Life-cycle (LCA) basis
chosen.powerSource: EC2 g4dn.xlarge / Tesla T4 / average of nvidia-smi inside the job container (2026-08-12, 15 s at 1 Hz). Limit 70 W. Measured during a light workload

comparedWith.gridSource: Electricity Maps, Grid in Review 2025 — flow-traced (consumption-based, imports included). Production-based on the same page: 19.0. Life-cycle (LCA) basis
comparedWith.powerSource: EC2 g4dn.xlarge / Tesla T4 / average of nvidia-smi inside the job container (2026-08-12, 15 s at 1 Hz). Limit 70 W. Measured during a light workload

comparedWith.gridSource: Hydro-Québec published value. Life-cycle (LCA) basis covering generation, transmission and distribution. No year is stated on the page
comparedWith.powerSource: Placeholder from the NVIDIA L4 TDP of 72 W. Not measured

comparedWith.gridSource: EPA eGRID2023 State Output Emission Rates (CO2e 365.0 lb/MWh). Direct emissions at generation
comparedWith.powerSource: Placeholder from the NVIDIA L4 TDP of 72 W. Not measured

comparedWith.gridSource: Japan Ministry of the Environment / METI substitute factor for electricity suppliers, 0.000429 t-CO2/kWh. Direct emissions at generation. The IEA-based carbon intensity of Japanese generation (2023) is about 485
comparedWith.powerSource: Placeholder from the NVIDIA L4 TDP of 72 W. Not measured

comparedWith.gridSource: Government of Alberta. Direct emissions at generation. 2005: 907 → 2019: 629 → 2024: 335
comparedWith.powerSource: Placeholder from the NVIDIA L40S TDP of 350 W. Not measured

notComparable.gridSource: Japan Ministry of the Environment / METI substitute factor, 0.000429 t-CO2/kWh. Not the actual factor of any specific site's electricity contract
notComparable.reason: この環境の消費電力が未取得のため、炭素排出量を算出できない。実測してから登録すること。

differenceFromHighest.note: A difference between estimates, not a reduction against a baseline.
